events.name: My Floating Home
events.description: South African-born Linda, her husband Mark and Coco the cat share a one-bedroom floating home on Tagg's Island in Hampton, Surrey. It's an idyllic location, but their home is also their workplace and it's starting to feel a bit cramped. The couple want to stay put in their exclusive location, so Linda has hatched an ambitious plan to buy the boat next door and do it up all by herself. It's a huge challenge and it remains to be seen whether enthusiasm and passion will be enough to get the job done

events.name: Edwardian Farm
events.description: Archaeologists Alex Langlands and Peter Ginn team up with historian Ruth Goodman as they move to Morwellham Quay in Devon and try to take the port - once one of Britain's busiest - back to life as it was during its Edwardian heyday. They begin by setting up home in a cottage as they wait for the arrival of their first livestock, and set out to prepare the ground for cropping by making tons of quicklime fertiliser to neutralise the acidity of the soil

events.name: Garden Rescue
events.description: Five years ago, David and John hoped the team could change their long plot into somewhere suitable for their wedding. Charlie Dimmock goes back to Shoreham-by-Sea in West Sussex to find the formal garden she designed and built has grown into something completely different as the middle section is now a secret garden hidden from view. Inspired by their hard work at keeping the garden, Charlie helps the couple add to it. The presenter also checks in with Kim in Cwmcarn, Monmouthshire, the owner of the steepest garden the team ever built, and a garden in Cosham, Hampshire, that helped one man on the road to recovery

events.description: Alan Titchmarsh heads to Swindon to surprise Lorraine, a retired RAF servicewoman and devoted charity volunteer. Because of a spinal injury, Lorraine struggles with mobility issues and lives with her full-time support team - Leonbergers Poppy and Doris. Poppy is a retired therapy dog and Doris is Lorraine's assistance dog, and helps with chores such as laundry and fetching household items. The team creates a fabulous low-maintenance garden as a calming retreat for both Lorraine and her canine family
